asset_variants_input_sha256.name: asset_variants_input_sha256
asset_variants_input_sha256.value: length("asset_variants"."input_sha256") = 64 AND "asset_variants"."input_sha256" = lower("asset_variants"."input_sha256") AND "asset_variants"."input_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

asset_variants_logo_digest.name: asset_variants_logo_digest
asset_variants_logo_digest.value: "asset_variants"."logo_digest" = 'none' OR (length("asset_variants"."logo_digest") = 64 AND "asset_variants"."logo_digest" = lower("asset_variants"."logo_digest") AND "asset_variants"."logo_digest" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

asset_variants_public_watermark.name: asset_variants_public_watermark
asset_variants_public_watermark.value: "asset_variants"."storage_scope" != 'PUBLIC' OR (("asset_variants"."watermark_profile" = 'brand-standard-v1' AND "asset_variants"."watermark_profile_id" IS NULL AND "asset_variants"."watermark_config_digest" = 'none' AND "asset_variants"."logo_digest" != 'none' AND "asset_variants"."watermark_anchor" IN ('top-left', 'top-right', 'bottom-left', 'bottom-right') AND "asset_variants"."watermark_opacity_percent" IS NULL AND "asset_variants"."watermark_scale_percent" IS NULL) OR ("asset_variants"."watermark_profile" = 'brand-centered-v2' AND "asset_variants"."watermark_profile_id" IS NOT NULL AND "asset_variants"."watermark_config_digest" != 'none' AND "asset_variants"."logo_digest" != 'none' AND "asset_variants"."watermark_anchor" = 'center' AND "asset_variants"."watermark_opacity_percent" BETWEEN 10 AND 90 AND "asset_variants"."watermark_scale_percent" BETWEEN 20 AND 90))

asset_variants_preprocess_private.name: asset_variants_preprocess_private
asset_variants_preprocess_private.value: "asset_variants"."usage" != 'preprocess' OR ("asset_variants"."storage_scope" = 'PRIVATE' AND "asset_variants"."watermark_profile" = 'none' AND "asset_variants"."watermark_profile_id" IS NULL AND "asset_variants"."watermark_config_digest" = 'none' AND "asset_variants"."logo_digest" = 'none' AND "asset_variants"."watermark_anchor" = 'none' AND "asset_variants"."watermark_opacity_percent" IS NULL AND "asset_variants"."watermark_scale_percent" IS NULL)

asset_variants_ready_output.name: asset_variants_ready_output
asset_variants_ready_output.value: "asset_variants"."status" != 'READY' OR ("asset_variants"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND length("asset_variants"."sha256") = 64 AND "asset_variants"."byte_size" > 0)

assets_sha256.name: assets_sha256
assets_sha256.value: length("assets"."sha256") = 64 AND "assets"."sha256" = lower("assets"."sha256") AND "assets"."sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

publication_operations_failure_state.name: publication_operations_failure_state
publication_operations_failure_state.value: ("publication_operations"."status" = 'FAILED' AND "publication_operations"."internal_error_code" IS NOT NULL AND "publication_operations"."failure_stage" IS NOT NULL) OR ("publication_operations"."status" != 'FAILED' AND "publication_operations"."internal_error_code" IS NULL AND "publication_operations"."failure_stage" IS NULL)

site_branding_profile_distinct.name: site_branding_profile_distinct
site_branding_profile_distinct.value: "site_branding"."active_watermark_profile_id" IS NULL OR "site_branding"."draft_watermark_profile_id" IS NULL OR "site_branding"."active_watermark_profile_id" != "site_branding"."draft_watermark_profile_id"

site_content_commission_intro.name: site_content_commission_intro
site_content_commission_intro.value: "site_content"."commission_intro" IS NULL OR (length(trim("site_content"."commission_intro")) BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND "site_content"."commission_intro" NOT GLOB '*[<>]*')

site_content_contact_douyin.name: site_content_contact_douyin
site_content_contact_douyin.value: "site_content"."contact_douyin" IS NULL OR ("site_content"."contact_douyin" = trim("site_content"."contact_douyin") AND length("site_content"."contact_douyin") BETWEEN 2 AND 30 AND "site_content"."contact_douyin" NOT GLOB '*[ <>]*')

site_content_commission_estimate_note.name: site_content_commission_estimate_note

site_content_commission_email_action.name: site_content_commission_email_action
site_content_commission_email_action.value: "site_content"."commission_email_action" IS NULL OR (length(trim("site_content"."commission_email_action")) BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND "site_content"."commission_email_action" NOT GLOB '*[<>]*')

site_content_about_studio_facts.name: site_content_about_studio_facts
site_content_about_studio_facts.value: "site_content"."about_studio_facts" IS NULL OR (length(trim("site_content"."about_studio_facts")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1200 AND "site_content"."about_studio_facts" NOT GLOB '*[<>]*')

site_content_about_making_scope.name: site_content_about_making_scope
site_content_about_making_scope.value: "site_content"."about_making_scope" IS NULL OR (length(trim("site_content"."about_making_scope")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1200 AND "site_content"."about_making_scope" NOT GLOB '*[<>]*')

site_content_basic_terms.name: site_content_basic_terms
site_content_basic_terms.value: "site_content"."basic_terms" IS NULL OR (length(trim("site_content"."basic_terms")) BETWEEN 1 AND 8000 AND "site_content"."basic_terms" NOT GLOB '*[<>]*')

site_content_contact_anti_scam.name: site_content_contact_anti_scam
site_content_contact_anti_scam.value: "site_content"."contact_anti_scam" IS NULL OR (length(trim("site_content"."contact_anti_scam")) BETWEEN 1 AND 600 AND "site_content"."contact_anti_scam" NOT GLOB '*[<>]*')

upload_sessions_media_role.name: upload_sessions_media_role
upload_sessions_media_role.value: ("upload_sessions"."owner_type" = 'work' AND "upload_sessions"."media_role" IN ('design_sheet', 'studio_photo')) OR ("upload_sessions"."owner_type" = 'site' AND "upload_sessions"."owner_id" = 'home' AND "upload_sessions"."media_role" IN ('home_hero_landscape', 'home_hero_portrait')) OR ("upload_sessions"."owner_type" = 'site' AND "upload_sessions"."owner_id" = 'branding' AND "upload_sessions"."media_role" = 'watermark_logo')

upload_sessions_asset_state.name: upload_sessions_asset_state
upload_sessions_asset_state.value: ("upload_sessions"."status" = 'COMPLETED' AND "upload_sessions"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("upload_sessions"."status" != 'COMPLETED' AND "upload_sessions"."asset_id" IS NULL)

upload_sessions_failure_state.name: upload_sessions_failure_state
upload_sessions_failure_state.value: ("upload_sessions"."status" = 'FAILED' AND "upload_sessions"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL AND "upload_sessions"."failure_stage" IS NOT NULL) OR ("upload_sessions"."status" != 'FAILED' AND "upload_sessions"."failure_code" IS NULL AND "upload_sessions"."failure_stage" IS NULL)

watermark_operations_failure_state.name: watermark_operations_failure_state
watermark_operations_failure_state.value: ("watermark_operations"."status" = 'FAILED' AND "watermark_operations"."internal_error_code" IS NOT NULL AND "watermark_operations"."failure_stage" IS NOT NULL) OR ("watermark_operations"."status" != 'FAILED' AND "watermark_operations"."internal_error_code" IS NULL AND "watermark_operations"."failure_stage" IS NULL)

work_assets_alt_text.name: work_assets_alt_text
work_assets_alt_text.value: "work_assets"."alt_text" IS NULL OR ("work_assets"."alt_text" = trim("work_assets"."alt_text") AND length("work_assets"."alt_text") BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

work_assets_crop.name: work_assets_crop
work_assets_crop.value: "work_assets"."crop_x" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "work_assets"."crop_y" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "work_assets"."crop_width" > 0 AND "work_assets"."crop_width" <= 1 AND "work_assets"."crop_height" > 0 AND "work_assets"."crop_height" <= 1 AND "work_assets"."crop_x" + "work_assets"."crop_width" <= 1 AND "work_assets"."crop_y" + "work_assets"."crop_height" <= 1

works_adoption_fields.name: works_adoption_fields
works_adoption_fields.value: ("works"."purpose" = 'adoption') OR ("works"."adoption_method" IS NULL AND "works"."business_status" IS NULL AND "works"."current_event_name" IS NULL AND "works"."price_amount_minor" IS NULL AND "works"."price_currency" IS NULL)

works_price_cny.name: works_price_cny
works_price_cny.value: ("works"."price_amount_minor" IS NULL AND "works"."price_currency" IS NULL) OR ("works"."purpose" = 'adoption' AND "works"."price_amount_minor" > 0 AND "works"."price_currency" = 'CNY')
